productArea.name: Remote browsers
productArea.scope: Add, edit, test, save, and delete remote browser endpoints, including URL validation, connection feedback, and saved settings. Monitor behavior and administering the external browser service are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Settings then Remote Browsers, and add or edit an endpoint to test or save it.
Select the Browser Engine monitor type, enable the remote browser option, and use its add control. Existing monitor Edit forms offer the same dialog.
